'''Krakin's Alehouse''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was established by an individual named [[Krakin]] and later fell into the hands of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Sossk]], who had owned it for fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Remember When" /> After the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] was deposed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Riboga]],<ref name="For Every Action: Preemptive Strike">{{LivingForce|For Every Action: Preemptive Strike}}</ref> a number of criminals who had formerly worked for Nirama visited Krakin's Alehouse and discussed the experiences that they had while working for Nirama.<ref name="Remember When" />

==Description==
The cantina was filled with a pale yellow mist and the sound of cheap music, which was played from a set of old speakers. The building contained a number of small, round tables that were surrounded by [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] chairs, for the patrons to sit on.<ref name="Remember When" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krakin's Alehouse was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in ''[[Remember When]]'', an article that was added to [[Wizards.com]] in [[2005]] as part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign.
